author: Linnaeus, 1758
status: 겨울철새 수만 마리 · 텃새 수십 마리
habitat: 호수, 댐, 하천, 저수지, 하구, 산간계곡

months.note: 산란기는 4~6월이며, 국내에서는 최근 강원 일부 산간계곡에서 드물게 번식이 확인되었다.

summary: 겨울철 전국의 호수, 댐, 하천, 저수지, 하구에서 흔히 무리를 지어 지내는 겨울철새이며, 최근 강원 일부 산간계곡에서 드물게 번식하는 것이 확인되어 국지적인 텃새이기도 하다. 잠수해 물고기를 사냥한다. 땅 위의 구멍이나 나무 구멍을 둥지로 쓰며, 한배에 알 9~10개를 낳아 32~35일 동안 품는다. 유라시아 대륙과 북아메리카 대륙의 아한대와 온대에서 번식하고 유럽, 인도 동부, 미얀마, 중국 동부, 한국, 일본, 북미 남부에서 월동한다.

sexes.male: 머리와 윗목은 녹색을 띤 검은색, 몸은 흰색, 등은 검은색이다.
sexes.female: 머리와 윗목은 갈색이고 턱밑은 희며, 목의 흰 띠가 갈색 머리와 회색 몸을 가른다. 머리에 뒤로 뻗은 댕기깃이 있다.

art.subject: Common Merganser (Mergus merganser), adult male in winter, as seen on Korean rivers from November to March: head and upper neck black with a green gloss, the head smooth and rounded with a slight bulge at the nape but no crest; lower neck, breast, flanks and belly white, often with a faint salmon-pink tinge; mantle black; rump and tail grey. Long, slender, serrated red bill with a black hooked tip; dark eye; orange-red legs.
art.pose: swimming low on a river with the head half submerged, searching for fish
art.scene: wide Korean river in winter with open flowing water; no people, buildings or text
views: adult male, side view standing on a riverside rock: green-glossed black head with no crest, long red bill with a hooked black tip, white body tinged pink, black back, grey tail, orange-red legs
adult female, side view swimming: chestnut-brown head with a shaggy crest at the back, white chin, brown neck sharply cut off from the white lower foreneck, grey body, long red bill
art.build: Large, long-bodied diving duck, about 65cm, larger and longer than a Mallard, swimming low with a long, flat back. Head large, neck thick. Bill red, long and narrow, about as long as the head, straight with a hooked tip and serrated edges for gripping fish. Legs short, orange-red, set far back. In flight straight, fast and low, with the long body, neck and bill held in a line; the male shows a large white inner wing.
avoid: Do not give the male a spiky crest or a streaked brown breast band — that is Red-breasted Merganser (Mergus serrator).
Do not paint a broad, flat duck bill; it is a narrow red saw-bill with a hooked tip.
Do not blend the female's brown neck gradually into the body; the border with the white foreneck is sharp.
Do not paint the male's body grey; it is white with a black back.
